docs.text:
Chicago area has a nice beach people don't think about it like that but lake Michigan if you didn't know it was a lake you would think it was an ocean 😊
The seasons can be wicked though especially the winter time.

No shade on spectacular ocean beaches, I’ve been blessed to visit many and I love em. And tbf, if you think “beach” only means hot weather and swimming, we can only do that here about half the year… still, the Great Lakes fall/winter beach scenes are also amazing and not to be missed.
absolutely delighted that i got to go to the beach today bc the great lakes also have beaches like isn't that incredible

yeah, I think this is the secret, you need to be able to dip in and out of the beach experience instead of making it a whole thing. Chicago was great from this (though I will readily concede that a Great Lakes beach isn’t quite the same)
I was going to say that I'd love to but the nearest one is over 1000km away, then I remembered that Lake Erie, replete with many wonderful beaches, is only 20Km away. I'll go to the beach.
My favorite Great Lakes beach wasn't on here, thank goodness. It's crowded enough already. gandernewsroom.com/2025/07/02/9...
Sadly I’m probably a 9 hour drive to the closest ocean beach—much closer to the Great Lakes!
🚨watch out great lakes, they're gonna fuk up my lk Michigan beach
I think I'd heard that. I like a good beach, so if I had lived there I would have liked that part. The closest I am to a beach is Lake Erie, and that's not exactly close!
Apparently you can get to Lake Erie in about 2 hours but that doesn't feel like what they mean by beach
